Callout.Name: Firearms Stolen from a Farm
Callout.Message: Shotgun cabinet forced at a farmhouse.
Callout.Advisory: Two weapons taken, owners were out.

Script.Line: The cabinet was bolted to the wall and they took the wall with it.
Two shotguns and a rifle. That is what is missing.
I know what that means. I know where they end up.

Lines.Approach: Cabinet forced, two gone. Whoever did it knew when they would be out.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
